Research Article Crafter v1.0.1

- Initial release with comprehensive documentation and usage guide.
- Implements a four-step workflow ("research-citation-hook-feedback") for creating in-depth, well-cited long-form content.
- Core features include topic research, structured outlines, section-by-section drafting, citation integration, hook/title optimization, and full-article review.
- Supports technical blogs, industry analysis, white papers, research reports, and in-depth reviews.
- Provides automation for file handling, command execution, external API calls, and information retrieval with integrated error handling and recovery.
- Offers detailed troubleshooting, safety guidelines, and FAQ for common usage and setup questions.
